_purpose: §63 3-core 정상 부하 profile qualification 사전등록 - docs/design/phase8-blue-green-preflight-incident.md §63과 동일 내용, 기계 판독용. 측정 전 커밋·푸시, 이후 수정하지 않는다.

decisions_from_61_62.section_60_status: preserved as-is, labeled non-reproduced diagnostic anomaly
decisions_from_61_62.topology_causation: not concluded - A-B-A showed A1/B/A2 had statistically indistinguishable active-pod CPU, CFS throttle, and latency regardless of preview presence
decisions_from_61_62.low_load_0_10_rps_excluded: yes - derived from 4-core (2026-09-16) calibration; A-B-A under 3-core showed 0.10 RPS sits at the SLO boundary in every leg

burst.pattern: base 0.025 RPS (60s) x5 alternating with pulse 0.10 RPS (20s) x4
burst.pulse_length_rationale: 20s < slo_judge.LATENCY_PERSIST_SEC (30s) so a single pulse cannot mechanically satisfy the sustained-violation window by construction; genuine violation still depends on measured latency

payload.note: identical to existing load generator payload - only RPS/structure changed

session_procedure: cooldown 60s + clean preflight before next session
pass_conditions: t_slo == null (true 30s-sustained violation via slo_judge.evaluate/find_t_slo over full baseline+load+drain probe timeline, NOT run_candidate's instantaneous per-stage P95 flag)
no unexpected promotion (active pod UID unchanged)
active/preview Endpoint isolation maintained (checked via actual Endpoints objects, not Service selector)
no missing/NaN/stale metric windows (existing build_dataset strict window validation, no new logic)
cleanup succeeds, Rollout Healthy, single revision restored
no extreme_latency_detected (P95 > 5x SLO threshold or max > 10x SLO threshold, a §60-recurrence check independent of the formal 30s-sustained rule)
observed_constant_zero_policy: if queue/cache stay exactly 0 across all valid windows, record as observed_constant_zero and do not fail the profile or raise load intensity
feature_preservation: 8 raw feature time series and generated 60s/15s windows (spanning the full multi-stage load period for burst)
active/preview CPU and working set (Prometheus historical query)
active pod CFS throttled-periods ratio (throttled-seconds metric does not exist on this cluster per §61.1 - periods ratio only)
queue/cache non-zero sample and window counts
Node CPU utilization/load1/iowait/MemAvailable (PSI attempted, recorded as unavailable if absent - not newly implemented)
valid/invalid window counts and exclusion reasons
stop_conditions: sustained SLO violation (t_slo is not null)
stop_behavior: stop immediately, do not run remaining profiles, do not adjust intensity/pulse on the spot, preserve raw data and report
